title: Robert F. Kennedy's 1968 letter to a UFO researcher

tellings.quote: writing to um a uh a UFO researcher back in ' 68. It's dated one month before they killed him.

plain: Robert F. Kennedy is said to have written a letter in 1968 to a UFO researcher connected with the Amalgamated Flying Saucer Clubs of America, a network of groups for people interested in flying saucers. A UFO researcher named Steven Greer brings it up on the show without naming a source. He says the letter is "dated one month before they killed him," which, if true, would mean a leading politician was in touch with UFO researchers just before his death.
